live_test: Downloaded DCAD2026_CURRENT.ZIP live (195,234,711 bytes, matches the plan's ~195MB estimate; the ViewPDFs.aspx redirect URL is itself a direct download with no further redirect). COM_DETAIL.CSV really has BLDG_CLASS_DESC values 'APARTMENT (BRICK EXTERIOR)'/'APARTMENT (FRAME EXTERIOR)' (4,173 real apartment rows) and a real PCT_COMPLETE column that is a 0.00-1.00 fraction, not a 0-100 percent (1.00 = fully built, confirmed live: 4,072 of 4,173 real apartment rows sit at exactly 1.00, the rest spread from .00 to .95) -- filtering units>=20 and pct<1.00 with a real PROPERTY_NAME gave 57 real under-construction rows live totalling 10,525 units, e.g. 'PALLADIUM CARVER LIVING (TDHCA #6031)' 288 units at 0.60 complete, 'THE ARMSTRONG AT KNOX' 165 units at 0.0 complete. ACCOUNT_INFO.CSV really has DEED_TXFR_DATE (MM/DD/YYYY text), OWNER_NAME1, PHONE_NUM and PROPERTY_CITY, joined by the same ACCOUNT_NUM -- joining it to the 2,723 real apartment accounts with units>=20 and filtering DEED_TXFR_DATE>=2024-09-01 gave 455 real deed transfers live, e.g. 'ALENA' 216 units sold 2025-06-23 to ASD ALENA PROPERTY OWNER LLC (Dallas, TX); 'CORTLAND LAS COLINAS' 371 units sold 2026-01-21 to CRP/RPM LAS COLINAS OWNERS LP (Austin, TX).
notes: The plan's original guess of ~107 new-construction rows was in the right ballpark but not exact -- 57 is the real count once PCT_COMPLETE is read as a fraction (an earlier draft treated it as 0-100 and wrongly kept every fully-built row, since 1.0 < 100 is true). PHONE_NUM is blank on most rows live, so office_phone is often empty here -- never guessed, left blank per the plan's data-first rule; a later run can still web-search a phone only for the (Data first) allowed cases.
